items.heading: Mountain Chicken Stew
details: Key ingredients: frog legs, thyme, onion, tomato
Season frog legs with thyme, garlic and onion.
Brown the legs in a hot pan.
Simmer with tomato and seasoning until tender.
Serve the stew with rice or ground provisions.

items.heading: Callaloo Soup
details: Key ingredients: dasheen leaves, coconut milk, crab or salted meat, okra
Chop dasheen (callaloo) leaves finely.
Simmer the leaves with okra and coconut milk.
Add crab or salted meat for depth of flavor.
Cook until the leaves are soft and the soup is creamy, then serve hot.
